Company claims: GPT-6 Cyber's results are OpenAI's own; ChatGPT search at about 20% of Google's query volume is OpenAI's figure; Unitree's painting and chess are its CEO's account to the South China Morning Post.

The S&P 500 move is Thursday's intraday fall as AP reported it (more than 3%); the window closed before the US market close. Agility's $2.5 billion value and $1.8 million of 2025 sales are Forbes' figures.

post.text:

stories.title: OpenAI pledges to cover its future data centres' power costs after the midterms
stories.summary: Two days after the US midterms, OpenAI's National Community Compact pledged to cover electricity and grid costs for future data centres it owns and operates, limit NDAs with public officials and plan water use with each community.

predictions.note: After voters turned on data centres, OpenAI promised to pay for their power and grid costs and plan water use with each town: a voluntary, single-company step.

stories.title: Meta's president says building data centres is 'going to be harder' after the midterms
stories.summary: Speaking at the WSJ Tech conference, Meta president Dina Powell McCormick said data-centre construction is 'going to be harder' after the midterms, and that Meta is more optimistic about scaling up its existing sites.

predictions.note: Meta's president expects building new data centres to get harder after the US midterms: one company's view of a growing political constraint.

stories.title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber gets its highest cyber-risk rating, 'Critical'
stories.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber, built to find and exploit security flaws, only to approved security customers, rating it 'Critical', its highest cyber tier. OpenAI says it found 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox bugs, which Mozilla is fixing.

stories.title: OpenAI says ChatGPT search now equals about 20% of Google's query volume
stories.summary: OpenAI says ChatGPT search now handles about a fifth as many queries as Google, by its own count, Forbes reports.

stories.title: Greg Brockman says OpenAI should be ready to go public in 2027
stories.summary: OpenAI president Greg Brockman said at a WSJ tech conference that most of OpenAI's revenue now comes from enterprise sales and that he believes it will be ready to go public in 2027.

stories.title: AI stocks lead a slide that takes the S&P 500 down more than 3%
stories.summary: Another sell-off in stocks tied to the AI data-centre build-out pulled the S&P 500 down more than 3% on Thursday, erasing the previous day's gains, its best in three months, AP reported.

stories.title: Agility Robotics becomes the first US pure-play humanoid robot company on the stock market
stories.summary: Agility, maker of the Digit humanoid, began trading on Nasdaq as AGLT, valued at $2.5 billion on $1.8 million of 2025 sales, per Forbes. A year ago Figure AI's CEO told it, 'You'll be bankrupt in <12 months.'

predictions.note: Agility's Digit robots work for nine customers and earned $1.8 million in 2025: a public listing, but far from thousands of humanoids on live lines.

stories.title: About 600,000 Nvidia AI chips reportedly wait in Hong Kong for China's approval
stories.summary: About 600,000 of Nvidia's advanced AI chips are stored in Hong Kong awaiting shipment to mainland China as Beijing withholds import approval, two people familiar told Reuters.

stories.title: Taisei's AI-run tunnel-boring machine beats veteran operators on precision
stories.summary: Japanese contractor Taisei demonstrated a giant tunnel-boring machine operating autonomously with AI, and it outperformed veteran human operators on precision, Nikkei Asia reports.

stories.title: A YC start-up offers $200,000 for each of five unsolved materials science problems
stories.summary: Discovered Materials, a months-old YC start-up that uses AI to find chip materials, is offering $200,000 for each solution to five open materials science problems, $1 million in all.

stories.title: AI agents sent shopping for TVs and laptops got it wrong nearly half the time
stories.summary: In a study reported by Fortune, AI agents shopping for TVs and laptops messed up nearly 50% of the time; Gemini and Muse agents scored highest.

stories.title: Rep. Yassamin Ansari calls for a ban on artificial superintelligence
stories.summary: A day after the midterms, Rep. Yassamin Ansari (D-Ariz.) urged Democrats to pause advanced AI development, regulate the industry and ban artificial superintelligence outright.

predictions.note: A day after the midterms, a Democratic congresswoman urged her party to pause advanced AI and ban superintelligence: one lawmaker's agenda, not yet a national election issue.

stories.title: Unitree's founder says its GPT-6-powered robots paint and play chess without training
stories.summary: Unitree founder Wang Xingxing says its humanoid robots, running OpenAI's GPT-6, mastered painting and chess without training, and that the hard part left is a 'last-millimetre' mechanical gap, the South China Morning Post reports.

stories.title: China blocks SoftBank's $5.4 billion takeover of ABB's robotics business
stories.summary: China's state planner told SoftBank it will not allow its $5.4 billion acquisition of the robotics business of Swiss engineering group ABB, first reported by the Financial Times.

stories.title: Lab-grown human neurons steer a robot dog to its target
stories.summary: Researchers at Cortical Labs in Australia attached lab-grown human neurons to a robot dog and used them to steer it toward a goal on a simple map.
